subject: Comparing genotypes to a reference genome

messages.author: bd92de6505c48310
messages.subject: Comparing genotypes to a reference genome
parts:
Hi Dr. Broman,

In est.map, or for instance in running "imp", can I reference genotypes back to a reference genome instead of to the cross parents? 

For example, while several neighboring markers are all fixed for P1's genotype, the calls will show a mix of AA & BB if called from a reference.

Thank you
Annie

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Comparing genotypes to a reference genome
parts:
No. In R/qtl they need to be relative to the two cross parents.

karl
